A '''statue of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]''' was erected at the back of the [[Jedi Temple Planetarium]] within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was built to commemorate the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] after his death at the hands of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==History==
When Qui-Gon Jinn was killed by Darth Maul on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in 32 BBY, a statue was erected in the Temple Planetarium to commemorate his devotion to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The room was slightly expanded to accommodate the statue which was built in a small rotunda off the main chamber.

===Discovered===
[[Galen Marek]] [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|traveled to the Jedi Temple]] when he had felt himself drawn there. He infiltrated the Temple and stumbled across the Temple Planetarium in order to clear a path for himself. There, he remained ignorant that he had passed the statue of Master Jinn.
